name: Kick
blurb: A short, mean kick. No mana. It just arrives.

name: Heavy Swing
blurb: Put the shoulder into it. Slower than a kick, and it shows.

name: Sundering Chop
blurb: A chop that hates armor. Eirik sells the drill.

name: Breaker Swing
blurb: Two beats in one motion. For when one axe-fall is not enough.

name: Shardbolt
blurb: A splinter of ice. Costs mana and strikes one foe at a distance.

name: Rimefield
blurb: Cold that clings. Slows every foe near your target.

name: Glacier Spike
blurb: A thicker spear of ice. It costs more and it means it.

name: Whiteout
blurb: The air turns to snow. Everything nearby slows and stings.

name: Frostbind
blurb: Ice on the joints of one foe. They keep coming, slower.

name: Kindle
blurb: A small fire under the ribs. It puts a little health back.

name: Ember Rot
blurb: A coal under the hide. It keeps burning after the cast.

name: Gale Hex
blurb: A mean wind. Everyone near the target has to lean into it.

name: Ancestor Ward
blurb: The old blood stands up in your arms. Your next blows hit harder.

name: Sneak
blurb: Spend guile and go quiet. Eyes lose you until you are close, or you strike.

name: Backstab
blurb: The knife only likes a turned back. From the front it refuses.

name: Evade
blurb: A loose stance. The next blows are likely to find air.

name: Poisoned Blade
blurb: A dirty edge. The cut is small. The sick that follows is not.

name: Vanish
blurb: Drop the fight and the sight of you together. Guile, not courage.

name: Frenzy
blurb: Spend rage on one ugly hit. Rage climbs when your blows land, and a kill feeds you.

name: Cleave
blurb: Both hatchets, one motion. It spends less rage than Frenzy.

name: Execution
blurb: The last chop. It wants a full belly of rage.

name: Blood Feast
blurb: Bite the rage and turn it into blood. A big mend, if you have the fury.

name: Fist
blurb: The hand, not the axe. Quick, and it does not ask for mana.

name: Mend
blurb: A light mend. Enough to stay standing, not enough to feel proud.

name: Snare
blurb: A root of cold around one pair of feet.

name: Bear Heart
blurb: The snow bear's nerve, borrowed. Your blows land heavier for a while.

name: Deep Mend
blurb: A slower, deeper knit. It costs more mana and it shows.

name: Shoulder Rush
blurb: A step and a shoulder. It puts you in their face and keeps you there.

name: Second Wind
blurb: You catch a breath. The worst of the blood stops.

name: Oath Axe
blurb: The last promise of the axe. Slow, and it means the promise.

name: Peat Bind
blurb: Bog-roots on one pair of feet. They keep coming, poorly.

name: Cinder Mend
blurb: A hotter knit than Kindle. It spends more of the fire.

name: Ashen Circle
blurb: A ring of spent coals. Everything near the target has to stand in it.

name: Hamstring
blurb: A low cut. The limp stays after the knife is gone.

name: Night Step
blurb: A longer quiet than Sneak. Eyes lose you until you strike.

name: Kingsbane
blurb: The knife for a turned back that matters. From the front it still refuses.

name: Red Sweep
blurb: A wide cut that spends rage and does not apologize.

name: War Blood
blurb: Turn a belly of rage back into blood. Smaller than a feast, sooner ready.

name: Last Howl
blurb: The ugly one. It wants the rage you have been saving.

name: Pack Call
blurb: The snow wolves answer. Your blows land heavier for a while.

name: Deep Root
blurb: A thicker root than Snare. One foe, and the ground keeps them.

name: Elder Mend
blurb: The old knit. Slow to come back, and it shows.

name: Ice Needle
blurb: A thin, mean spear. Quicker than Glacier Spike, and it still costs.

name: Rime Wall
blurb: A standing sheet of rime. Everyone near the target has to push through it.

name: Pale Star
blurb: One cold star, thrown. It is the expensive one.

name: Iron Guard
blurb: A braced guard. Blows land heavier for a while.

name: Cleaving Oath
blurb: The oath after the axe. Slow, and it means the last of it.

name: Bog Bolt
blurb: A heavier peat. One foe, and the feet stay slow.

name: Winter Mend
blurb: The deep knit, paid for in mana. It shows.

name: Vein Cut
blurb: A cut that keeps paying after the knife is gone.

name: Silent End
blurb: The quiet knife for a turned back. From the front it still refuses.

name: Red Feast
blurb: Turn a belly of rage into blood. Smaller than a kill, sooner ready.

name: Blood Howl
blurb: The howl that spends what you have been saving.

name: Pack Mend
blurb: The pack lends a knit. It costs more than a light mend.

name: Elder Root
blurb: The old root. One foe, and the ground keeps them longer.

name: Shard Lance
blurb: A longer spear of ice. It still costs.

name: Black Rime
blurb: The cold Ysolde would recognize. Everyone near the target stands in it.

name: Quiet Mend
blurb: A small, clean mend. The chapel sells it first.

name: Pale Spark
blurb: A thin spark. Bones take it worse than the living.

name: Linger Light
blurb: A mend that keeps working after the word is done.

name: Dawn Aegis
blurb: A pale ward. Blows land lighter for a while.

name: Grave Lamp
blurb: A harder spark, and crueler to bones.

name: Wellspring
blurb: The deep mend. It spends more of the light.

name: Last Light
blurb: A light that waits. If you fall while it holds, it pulls you back.

name: Hymn Mend
blurb: A mend and a lingering light together.

name: Second Dawn
blurb: The last page. A large mend, and the light that pulls you back.

name: Hush
blurb: A word that stops one foe where they stand.

name: Drift
blurb: Feet that forget their hurry.

name: Veil Spring
blurb: Mana comes easier for a while.

name: Glass Needle
blurb: A thin, mean point of force. It is not the point of the hall.

name: Still Room
blurb: A longer hush. One foe, held.

name: Deep Veil
blurb: A thicker tide of mana.

name: Borrowed Will
blurb: One foe follows you, for a while. Then they remember themselves.

name: Hush All
blurb: A short hush on everyone near the target.

name: Long Borrow
blurb: The long version. One foe stays yours longer.

name: Oath Cut
blurb: A cut with the oath blade. No mana. It just arrives.

name: Small Grace
blurb: A small mend, for the one holding the shield.

name: Bell
blurb: A ring off the shield. One foe stops.

name: Challenge
blurb: Make them look at you. The cut is small. The hate is not.

name: Second Grace
blurb: A larger mend than the first grace.

name: Lamp Stun
blurb: A brighter stop. One foe, held longer.

name: Vow Mend
blurb: The oath turned inward. A deep mend.

name: Bulwark
blurb: The shield remembers. Blows land lighter.

name: Dawn Oath
blurb: The last oath. A heavy cut, and the foe stops.

name: Cinder Bolt
blurb: A thrown cinder. It is the first page.

name: Call Ember
blurb: Shape an ember beside you. It takes Attack, Follow, Stay, and Dismiss.

name: Hearth Crumb
blurb: Two trail rations, from nothing you were carrying.

name: Flare
blurb: A hotter cinder. It still costs.

name: Scorch
blurb: Cinders on everyone near the target.

name: Bright Coal
blurb: Four trail rations. The ember hall calls this practical.

name: Cinder Rain
blurb: A meaner bolt. One foe, and it shows.

name: Ember Star
blurb: The expensive one. One star of cinder.

name: Iron Line
blurb: A longer cut. It asks for the room.

name: Shield Break
blurb: The blow that finds the gap in a guard.

name: Hold the Gate
blurb: You brace. Blows land heavier for a while.

name: War Step
blurb: One step, and the axe is already there.

name: Last Wall
blurb: The last of the guard. Slow, and it means it.

name: Peat Lance
blurb: A heavier peat, thrown.

name: Blood Knit
blurb: The deep knit, paid in mana.

name: Ash Tide
blurb: Ash on everyone near the target.

name: Winter Hex
blurb: One foe, and the cold stays on the feet.

name: The Old Cold
blurb: The cold the peaks remember. Everyone near the target stands in it.

name: Quiet Vein
blurb: A cut that keeps paying.

name: Side Step
blurb: You are not where the blow lands.

name: Throat Cut
blurb: From behind, it ends more than it starts. From the front it still refuses.

name: Smoke Step
blurb: You go quiet. The next step is not announced.

name: The Last Knife
blurb: The quiet knife at the end of the list.

name: Red Line
blurb: A cut that spends rage.

name: Gut Howl
blurb: The howl and the axe together.

name: Blood Price
blurb: Turn rage into blood. It is not free.

name: Twin Ruin
blurb: Both axes, one breath.

name: The Red End
blurb: The last of the rage, spent on one foe.

name: Den Mend
blurb: The den lends a knit.

name: Wolf Snare
blurb: The ground takes a foe's feet.

name: Pack Ward
blurb: The pack stands in front of the next blow.

name: Old Fang
blurb: One fang, thrown a long way.

name: Den Mother
blurb: The deep mend, and it keeps mending.

name: Glass Spear
blurb: A spear of ice with no patience.

name: Rime Crown
blurb: A crown of rime on everyone near the target.

name: Pale Needle
blurb: Thin, fast, and it still costs.

name: Star Well
blurb: Cold stars, and they land on the crowd.

name: The Last Winter
blurb: The expensive cold. One foe, and it shows.

name: Grave Light
blurb: A light that hates bones.

name: Quiet Ward
blurb: A ward, held quietly.

name: Last Rite
blurb: The mend you keep for when the first one was not enough.

name: Bone Lamp
blurb: Brighter than the grave light. Bones take it worse.

name: Dawn Mend
blurb: The last light. It pulls a great deal of you back.

name: Soft Word
blurb: A word, and the foe stops.

name: Thin Will
blurb: A shorter stop, sooner ready.

name: Hush Field
blurb: The hush spreads. Feet slow.

name: Borrowed Step
blurb: You borrow the next moment. They do not get it.

name: The Long Hush
blurb: The last hush. It holds.

name: Oath Strike
blurb: The oath, in the blade.

name: Small Dawn
blurb: A grace, larger than the first.

name: Oath Bell
blurb: The bell. One foe stops.

name: Vow Ward
blurb: The vow stands up in front of you.

name: The Kept Oath
blurb: The oath you kept for the end of the list.

name: Cinder Lance
blurb: A longer cinder.

name: Ember Field
blurb: Cinders on everyone near the target.

name: Second Ration
blurb: Trail rations, again, from nothing you carried.

name: Star Cinder
blurb: One bright cinder. It costs.

name: Cinder Crown
blurb: The last of the ember hall. It lands on the crowd.

name: Briar Mend
blurb: A small mend from the green.

name: Thorn Bolt
blurb: One thorn, thrown.

name: Creeping Rot
blurb: A rot that keeps working.

name: Rootbind
blurb: Roots take the feet. They do not let go quickly.

name: Barkskin
blurb: You put the bark on yourself.

name: Seed Mend
blurb: A mend that keeps growing.

name: Bramble Field
blurb: Briars on everyone near the target.

name: Vine Lash
blurb: A longer vine.

name: Grove Mend
blurb: The grove lends a larger mend.

name: Spore Cloud
blurb: Spores on the crowd.

name: Living Bark
blurb: The bark stays longer.

name: Thorn Rain
blurb: Thorns on everyone near the target.

name: Old Growth
blurb: The old rot. It stays.

name: The Green Crown
blurb: The last mend of the grove, and it keeps mending.

name: Quick Shot
blurb: One arrow. The bow is already in your hand.

name: Knife Jab
blurb: When they get close. Light, and mean.

name: Marked Trail
blurb: You read the ground. Breath comes easier.

name: Pinning Shot
blurb: An arrow in the foot.

name: Sidestep
blurb: You are not where the blow lands.

name: Volley
blurb: Arrows on everyone near the target.

name: Calm Beast
blurb: A beast listens, for a while. It is not a promise about people.

name: Hunter's Eye
blurb: One careful shot.

name: Thicket Step
blurb: You go quiet. The trail hides you.

name: Arrow Rain
blurb: The expensive volley.

name: Second Mark
blurb: You already know where it will land.

name: Wild Knit
blurb: The wild lends a small mend. Animal-friendly, which includes you.

name: Long Shot
blurb: Far, and it costs.

name: The Last Arrow
blurb: The arrow at the end of the list.

name: Grove Root
blurb: The root that does not hurry.

name: Low Shot
blurb: A low shot. The feet slow.
